data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Singapore Marriages: First Marriages data was reported at 21,806.000 Number in 2017. This records an increase from the previous number of 21,364.000 Number for 2016. Singapore Marriages: First Marriages data is updated yearly, averaging 20,482.000 Number from Dec 1970 (Median) to 2017, with 48 observations. Singapore Marriages: First Marriages data remains active status in CEIC and is reported by Department of Statistics. The data is categorized under Global Database’s Singapore – Table SG.G007: Vital Statistics: Marriages & Divorces.
